properties.displayName: GO-PRD-SENTINEL-030 Powerview Add-DomainObjectAcl DCSync AD Extend Right
properties.query:
let TriggeredUsers =
SecurityAlert
| where DisplayName contains "GO-PRD-SENTINEL-030 Powerview Add-DomainObjectAcl DCSync AD Extend Right"
| where TimeGenerated >= ago(24h)
| extend A = parse_json(Entities)
| mvexpand A
| extend User = tostring(A.Name)
| where isnotempty(User)
| summarize make_list(User);
SecurityEvent
| where EventID == 5136
| extend EvData = parse_xml(EventData)
| extend LDAPDisplayName = tostring(parse_json(tostring(parse_json(tostring(EvData.EventData)).Data))[11].["#text"])
| where LDAPDisplayName !~ "nTSecurityDescriptor"
| extend AttributeValue = tostring(parse_json(tostring(parse_json(tostring(EvData.EventData)).Data))[13].["#text"])
| project-away EventData, EvData
| where AttributeValue contains "1131f6ad-9c07-11d1-f79f-00c04fc2dcd2" or AttributeValue contains "1131f6aa-9c07-11d1-f79f-00c04fc2dcd2"
| where SubjectUserSid !startswith "S-1-5-32-544"
| where SubjectUserName !in (TriggeredUsers)
| extend AccountCustomEntity = SubjectUserName, HostCustomEntity = Computer
